project: Breast Cancer Clinical Effect Extraction — frozen independent study-family evaluation
purpose: Once-only, predeclared clinical numerical extraction sanity audit on independent article families. No fine-tuning on these labels after scoring.

references.provenance: Original trial abstract: randomized phase II, continuous versus standard-dose palbociclib; confidence interval is 90%, not 95%.
Original Results, multivariate pCR model; odds ratio describes association with hormone-receptor status, NOT randomized treatment effect.

expected.description: RT hazard ratios reported for high, medium and low biomarker subgroups; no unqualified pooled treatment HR should be asserted.

references.provenance: Original Results: multiple subgroup-specific HRs; this test is a false-pooling guard, not a test of exact effect extraction.

expected.description: Current conservative commercial-intent public demo does not mine full text licensed CC BY-NC-ND without separate rights.

evaluation_policy.scoring: Report individual exact effect+CI matches and correct abstention/blocks, plus all extra unverified candidates; never claim clinical accuracy from these four checks.
evaluation_policy.frozen: Do not change V2 expected labels after first scoring to inflate results; create new evaluation set for subsequent versions.
